{"metadata":{"description":"基于Karpathy的wiki方法论搭建的插件，让你的DSH直接变身成LLM wiki，不需要Obsidian+Claudian插件，国内网络友好","id":"gh:1343695590","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"DSH-LLM-wiki-plugin","slug":"Vesna-Strivozha/DSH-LLM-wiki-plugin","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"基于Karpathy的wiki方法论搭建的插件，让你的DSH直接变身成LLM wiki，不需要Obsidian+Claudian插件，国内网络友好"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH LLM Wiki Plugin"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> An **Obsidian-style personal knowledge base** for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"LLM Wiki turns DeepSeek Harness into a lightweight Obsidian: you drop source files in, the LLM **inc"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rementally builds and maintains a persistent, interlinked wiki**, and you then **ask questions in th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e chat that are grounded in your knowledge base** — with page citations."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Feature | What it does |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| 🗂 **One-click workspace** | Pick a directory and build the wiki skeleton (`raw/`, `wiki/`, `index."},{"id":"p8s2","text":"md`, `log.md`, `schema.md`). |
| 📥 **Upload + confirm** | Drag or select files, review them in a con"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"firm dialog, then write to `raw/`. |
| 🧠 **Auto-ingest** | The LLM reads `raw/` and generates/update"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s `wiki/` pages, with a progress bar and PDF text extraction. |
| 🕸 **Knowledge graph** | Force-dire"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"cted graph of `[[wikilinks]]` with zoom/pan and click-to-open. |
| 🩺 **Self-check (lint)** | Reports"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" orphan pages, isolated pages, and dead links. |
| 📖 **Read in place** | Markdown renderer plus an i"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"nline PDF viewer. |
| 💬 **Chat-grounded Q&A;** | The `wiki_query` tool and a prompt section answer q"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"uestions with page citations. |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"For chat Q&A;, add the `wiki_query` tool row to your agent preset (see the host README below)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Packages"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Package | Role |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `packages/dsh-llm-wiki` | Host engine (the installable bundle): ingest / search / graph / lint, th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e `wiki_query` tool, and a prompt section. |
